Plain notes file: edge cases for the matcher.

The word "acme.community" is NOT our domain — a domain term acme.com must
not swallow it. The word "AcmeCorp" (one token) is not the company name
either. The distinct word "Acme Corps" is unrelated to Acme Corp. A
possessive "Acme Corp's" contains the whole declared term; the suffix stays
natural after a patch.

Email addresses carry the domain twice: maria.silva@acme.com is one token
where the domain appears mid-token — the declared-term matcher will see
acme.com inside it (word boundary after the @ sign). That is a real
occurrence of the declared domain and SHOULD patch (the mailbox stays
readable as maria.silva@DOM-….invalid).

Repeat line for volume: Acme Corp, Acme Corp, Acme Corp, Maria Silva,
Maria Silva, acme.com, acme.com, sk-live-9f4a7b2c.
